nfl.oneThing: Miami will be without starting quarterback Malik Willis for at least four games, and defensive tackle Zach Sieler is out for the season.

headlines.title: Dolphins lose Sieler for the season and Willis for at least four games
headlines.summary: Miami's injury run got worse this week. Starting defensive tackle Zach Sieler will miss the rest of the season with a torn biceps, suffered on the first play of the loss to Detroit. Quarterback Malik Willis has gone on injured reserve with a groin injury that has progressed, so he must miss at least four games. Coach Jeff Hafley says Miami hopes he returns this season and still sees him as the starter, but Willis is getting a second opinion on whether he needs surgery. Starting centre Aaron Brewer is in the league's concussion protocol and missed Wednesday's practice.
headlines.whyItMatters: Miami are 1-7 and 14th in the AFC, so the next few weeks are about surviving without Willis.

headlines.title: Cardinals turn to rookie Carson Beck against the Rams
headlines.summary: Arizona will start their third quarterback in three weeks. Gardner Minshew went on injured reserve after a UCL injury to his throwing arm in Sunday's game at Seattle. Third-round rookie Carson Beck makes his NFL debut at home against the Rams on Sunday. He spent the first eight weeks as the emergency third quarterback and was inactive on game days. Coach Mike LaFleur says the moment won't be too big for him.
headlines.whyItMatters: Arizona are 3-6 and 14th in the NFC, so the young quarterback is being thrown in with little time to settle.

headlines.title: Keenan Allen heads to the 49ers for a sixth-round pick
headlines.summary: Keenan Allen was traded from the 2-7 Colts to San Francisco for a 2027 sixth-round pick. He learned of the deal on Tuesday, flew out that night and took his physical the next morning. The 34-year-old says joining a contender has him feeling energised. The Colts have traded four starters in recent weeks, and quarterback Daniel Jones says he isn't happy about it, though he understands it's outside the players' control. The 49ers are 7-1 and lead the NFC.
headlines.whyItMatters: For the Colts it's a sign of a rebuild. For the 49ers, Allen is a veteran addition to a team already at the top of the conference.

headlines.title: Philip Rivers is set to become NC State's head coach
headlines.summary: Sources told ESPN that Philip Rivers will be NC State's new head football coach, with the board of trustees expected to finalise the contract after a meeting on Friday. Rivers played quarterback for the Wolfpack from 2000 to 2003 and broke nearly every school and ACC record. He has never coached college football. He has spent six seasons as coach at St. Michael Catholic High School in Alabama, and asked to finish that season first. Dave Doeren was fired on October 24.
headlines.whyItMatters: It's a college story rather than an NFL one, but it's another former NFL quarterback moving into coaching.

teamNews.title: Mendoza is the Raiders' starter after the Cousins trade
teamNews.text: No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza calls the chance a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He starts against the reigning Super Bowl champion Seahawks in Week 10, and coach Klint Kubiak says the Raiders won't be peeling back anything. Aidan O'Connell has moved to No. 2 on the depth chart behind him, after the Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota.

teamNews.title: Seahawks rule out Darnold for Week 10
teamNews.text: Seattle won't have Sam Darnold for the Raiders game, and his return could come after the bye in Week 12. Drew Lock was limited in practice on Wednesday with an elbow and oblique injury.

teamNews.title: Raiders injury notes for Week 10
teamNews.text: Trey Zuhn III (centre, concussion) was limited in practice on Wednesday and is questionable, with a reported timeline of around Sunday 15 November. Folorunso Fatukasi (shoulder) and Thomas Booker IV (ankle) are also questionable.

nba.oneThing: Boston beat Philadelphia 123–101 to go 9–2, with Paul George scoring 36 points and hitting six threes.

headlines.title: Paul George scores 36 as Boston beat the 76ers 123–101
headlines.summary: Paul George had 36 points, six threes and five rebounds as the Celtics won 123–101 at Philadelphia. Jayson Tatum added 21 points and six rebounds. Payton Pritchard had a team-high +26 and made timely buckets throughout. Boston are 9–2 and Philadelphia drop to 9–3 after the loss.
headlines.whyItMatters: Boston sit first in the East and Philadelphia are second, so this is a head-to-head result at the top of the conference.

headlines.title: Kings fall to 1–10 after a Magic win, as Plumlee signs
headlines.summary: Orlando beat Sacramento 107–100. Franz Wagner had 33 points, seven rebounds and seven assists, and Anthony Black added 26 points and four steals. Darius Acuff Jr. scored 29 and Zach LaVine had 31 for the Kings. Sacramento are tied with Utah and Milwaukee for the league's worst record. Veteran centre Mason Plumlee is signing with the Kings, his representatives told ESPN.
headlines.whyItMatters: Sacramento are 14th in the West, and a 1–10 start leaves them a long way back.

headlines.title: Portland beat Oklahoma City 123–103
headlines.summary: Portland beat the Thunder 123–103 in a game between two winning teams. Damian Lillard had 25 points and Deni Avdija had 24 points, six rebounds and eight assists. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 26 for Oklahoma City, with eight rebounds, and Jared McCain added 21 points. Portland move to 7–3, and the Thunder drop to 8–3 after the loss.
headlines.whyItMatters: Both teams are near the top of the West, with Oklahoma City sixth and Portland eighth.

headlines.title: Giannis has 30 and 11 as Miami beat Utah 115–109
headlines.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 30 points and 11 rebounds as Miami beat Utah 115–109. Davion Mitchell added 19 points and eight assists. Darryn Peterson scored 25 and Ace Bailey 23 for Utah. The Jazz are 1–10 and on a nine-game losing streak.
headlines.whyItMatters: Miami are 5–6 and seventh in the East. Utah are 15th in the West.

teamNews.title: Wembanyama scores 40 as the Spurs win their ninth straight
teamNews.text: Victor Wembanyama had 40 points and nine blocks in 25 minutes in the 122–96 win at Phoenix. San Antonio are 9–2 and second in the West. Air Alamo says his dunk surge is the clearest sign the offence is clicking, and the Spurs lead the league in fast-break points while playing one of its slowest paces.

teamNews.title: Mason Plumlee to sign with the Kings after Spurs stint
teamNews.text: Mason Plumlee, entering his 14th NBA season, is signing with Sacramento, his representatives told ESPN. He spent part of last season with San Antonio.
